spans.s:
r. 1st cl. (सञ्चति)
To go.

r. 1st cl. (सजति)
To embrace, to cling or adhere to, to be in contact or connexion with.
With अव prefixed,
to hand down from, to be suspended.
With वि and आङ्,
to struggle together.
With आङ्,
to be attached or devoted to.
(उ) षञ्जु r. 1st cl. (सञ्जति-ते)
To go.

r. 1st cl. (सञ्जति)
To go or move.

BRAHMĀ.
2

ŚIVA.
f. (-ञ्जा)
A she-goat.
E.
सम् uniformly, all (mankind), जन to be born, (or created by whom,) and ढ aff.

mfn. (-तः-ता-तं)
Afraid, timid.
E.
सम्, and चकित timid.

m. (-ञ्चत्)
Cheating, juggling.
E.
सम् together, चि to collect, अति Uṇādi aff. and the radical vowel rejected.

m. (-यः)
Heap, quantity, number, multitude.
E.
सम् together, चि to collect, aff. अच्.

m. (-य्यः)
A particular sacrifice, at which the juice of the acid Asclepias is drank.
E.
सम् together, चि to collect, participial aff. ण्यत् form irr. आय being substituted for the regular change: see सञ्चेय.

n. (-नं)
1 Collecting, gathering.
2 Collecting the ashes or bones of a body which has been burnt.
E.
सम् together, चि to collect, aff. ल्युट्.

mfn. (-यी-यिनी-यि)
Who or what collects.
E.
सम्, चि to collect, घिनुण् aff.

m. (-रः)
A defile, any narrow or difficult pass, a road along the edge of a mountain, or a bridge over a mountain stream, &c.
2 Difficult passage, travelling along almost impracticable routes.
3 A road, a way.
4 The body.
5 Killing.
E.
सम् before चर to go, aff. घ; also सञ्चार.

m. (-रः)
1 Difficult progress.
2 Difficulty, distress.
3 Leading, guiding.
4

Inciting.
5

Impelling, setting in motion.
6 Contagion, communication or transmission of disease.
7 Course, transition.
8 A gem supposed to be in the head of a serpent.
E.
सम् before चर to go, aff. घञ्: see सञ्चर, or सम् and चर to go, causal v., अच् aff.

nf. (-नं-ना)
Trembling, shaking.
E.
सम् before चल to go, युच् aff.

m. (-नः)
A bird, a hawk (?).

m. (-कः)
1 A leader, a guide.
2 An instigator.
3 An orator.
E.
सम्, चर to go, causal v., ण्वुल् aff.

mfn. (-वी-विनी-वि)
Indigent, distressed, calamitous, in want of aid or protection.
E.
सञ्चार difficulty, and जीविन् living.

n. (-णं)
1 Leading, guiding.
2 Impelling, instigating.
3 Moving, setting in motion.
E.
सम् before चर to go, causal v., ल्युट् aff.

f. (-का)
1 A female messenger or go-between.
2 A bawd.
3 A brace, a pair.
4 Smell.
E.
सम् before चर to go, ण्वुल् aff.

mfn. (-तः-ता-तं)
1 Led, guided.
2 Driven, impelled.
3 Set in motion, moved.
4 Communicated, (as disease.)
E.
सम् before चर to go, causal v., क्त aff.

mfn. (-री-रिणी-रि)
1 Fickle, changeable, not permanent.
2 Moving, going.
3 Difficult, inaccessible.
4 Moving, putting in motion.
5 Transmitted, hereditary, (as disease.)
6 Contagious.
m. (-री)
1

Incense.
2

A division of the Bhāvas, the same as the व्यभित्रारिन् q. v. or the reverse of the स्थायिन् or fixed and steady sentiments.
3 Air, wind.
E.
सम् before चर to go, णिनि aff.

mfn. (-तः-ता-तं)
Assembled, accumulated, collected, gathered.
E.
सम्, चि to collect, क्त aff.

f. (-त्रा)
A plant, (Salvainia cucullata.)
E.
सम् completely, चित्र variegated.

n. (-नं)
Considering, reflecting.
E.
सम् before चिति to think, ल्युट् aff.

mfn. (-तः-ता-तं)
Deliberated, weighed.
E.
सम्, चिति to think, क्त aff.

ind.
Having considered, reflected, thoughtful.
E.
सम्, त्रिति to think, ल्यप् aff.

n. (-नं)
Breaking to pieces, reducing to powder.
E.
सम्, चूर्ण to grind, ल्युट् aff.

mfn. (-तः-ता-तं)
Cut or broken to pieces, pulverised, comminuted.
E.
सम् before चूर्ण to pound, क्त aff.

mfn. (-यः-या-यं)
To be collected or accumulated.
E.
सम्, त्रि to gather, ण्यत् aff.

mfn. (-तः-ता-तं)
Ordered, commanded.
E.
सम्, and चोदित ordered.

mfn. (-न्नः-न्ना-न्नं)
Covered.
E.
सम् completely, and छन्न covered.

mfn. (-न्नः-न्ना-न्नं)
1 Cut, cut off.
2 Dissipated, removed.
E.
सम् before छिद to cut, क्त aff.

n. (-नं)
Begetting, causing, producing.
E.
सम् before जन to be born, ल्युट् aff.

mfn. (-नः-ना-नं)
1 Knowing, observing.
2 Watching, who or what keeps watch.
E.
सम् before ज्ञा to know, शानच् aff.

mfn. (-यन्-यन्ती-यत्)
Begetting, producing, causing.
E.
सम् before जन to be born, causal v., शतृ aff.

n. (-नं)
A group of four houses.
E.
सम् together, जु to go, aff. युच्; also संयवन, and सञ्जीवन.

mfn. (-तः-ता-तं)
1 Born, produced.
2 Become.
E.
सम्, and जात born.

n. (-नं)
1 Animating, bringing to life.
2 A cluster of four houses.
3 A hill.
E.
सम् together, जीव to live, युच् aff.

f. (-क्षा)
Wish or attempt to preserve.
E.
सम् before गुह to hide, desid. v., अङ् and टाप् affs.

mfn. (-क्षुः-क्षुः-क्षु)
Wishing to preserve, hide, conceal, &c.
E.
सम् before गुह to hide, desid. v., उ aff.

m. (-रः)
1 Heat, the heat of fire, burning, scorching, a burn.
2 Fever.
E.
सम् before ज्वर to burn, aff. अच्.

mfn. (-रः-रा-रं)
Overcome by or affected with fever, fevered, feverish.
E.
सञ्ज्वर, and आतुर distressed.

mfn. (-री-रिणी-रि)
Affected with fever, fevered, diseased.
E.
सम् before ज्वर to be feverish, घिनुण् aff.

m. (-नः)
A lizard, a chameleon.
E.
स with, अञ्जन unguent.
